description: Central Bank of S L - Legal Rate of Interest Shell be 11.64% Per annum
reasoning: This gazette notification announces the determination of the Legal Rate of Interest by the Monetary Board under the Civil Procedure Code. It involves a regulatory change to an existing legal framework (specifically, an amendment to the Civil Procedure Code), making it a Legal/Regulatory matter. The content does not involve government structure/personnel changes, land, commercial registrations, elections, public service, judicial appointments, or other specialized categories that would take precedence.
